objective: SS-002: Establish the reference-data spine with PostgreSQL 16 migrations, idempotent seed data (12 sectors, 52 NSE stocks, holidays, sessions), and Go pgx metadata store.

requirements.text: Versioned SQL migrations up/down for sectors, stocks, exchange_holidays, market_sessions
requirements.acceptance: make migrate-up creates all 4 tables with correct indexes; make migrate-down cleanly removes them without dropping preloaded timescaledb
make seed executed twice yields identical row counts (INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING); 12 sectors, ~50 NSE stocks, 2 years NSE holidays, 2 muhurat sessions; 0 stocks with null sector_id

requirements.text: Go MetadataStore repository with typed structs and pgx
requirements.acceptance: internal/store/metadata implements GetStockBySymbol, ListStocksBySector, IsTradingDay, SessionFor with typed ErrNotFound
All application date logic explicitly evaluates in Asia/Kolkata (e.g. UTC 20:00 rolls over to next IST day); timestamps TIMESTAMPTZ

requirements.text: ADR 0002 documenting Symbol vs. Instrument Key
requirements.acceptance: docs/adr/0002-symbol-vs-instrument-key.md accepted with synthetic relational ID, UI symbol, and Upstox instrument_key separation

packages.title: Metadata Schema Contract & ADR
packages.acceptance: Contract frozen at v1 and ADR 0002 accepted

packages.title: Deterministic Idempotent Seeds
packages.acceptance: Seeds for 12 sectors, 52 stocks, holidays, sessions pass twice idempotently with 0 null sectors

packages.title: Go Metadata Repository Store
packages.acceptance: Go repository compiles with pgx and passes IST date conversion logic

packages.title: Makefile Targets & CI Integration
packages.acceptance: make migrate-up, migrate-down, migrate-status, and seed execute cleanly

packages.title: Testcontainers Integration & Monorepo Verification
packages.acceptance: make test and make lint pass; testcontainers verifies symbol lookup, holiday detection, down/up cycle
